redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-geographic fixtures only.
Public official pages used as pinned validation receipts; access does not imply bulk redistribution rights.
A layer-specific ASIG/authority release whose license, attribution, schema, coverage, validity, and reuse terms are pinned.
Licensed postal, address, cadastral, or civil-status data kept outside public artifacts unless contract review explicitly permits release.
Third-party or unclear-rights data may detect discrepancies but cannot become authoritative public geometry.

sources.production_scope: Pinned permitted postcode pages or contract release retaining office or branch class, locality, source edition, capture time, rights, and digest.
Pinned UPU addressing guide used for syntax and presentation rules only.

sources.provider: General Directorate of Civil Status via ASIG National Geoportal
sources.production_scope: Only layer-specific, provider-approved public address fields from a pinned service or release; civil-status and protected address fields remain excluded.

sources.provider: State Cadastre Agency (ASHK) via ASIG National Geoportal
sources.production_scope: Layer-specific permitted public cadastral fields and geometry only, pinned by object identifier, status, coverage, release, CRS, rights, and digest.
Layer-by-layer review only; each artifact pins responsible authority, license, service endpoint, schema, coverage, territorial vintage, update date, CRS, and digest.

artifact_partitions.rule: Posta Shqiptare evidence retains page or product, edition, office or branch class, locality, capture time, rights, and digest; contract rows never silently enter public artifacts.
National Address System assertions retain official object identity, hierarchy, status, coordinate provenance, service release, rights, and postal cross-check status.
Address-building and ASHK cadastral identities remain distinct until a common official identifier or reviewed crosswalk proves the link.
Rights-cleared address membership may generate a versioned, uncertainty-bearing derived surface; method and boundary clips remain reproducible and the result is never official geometry.
Every layer retains coverage and territorial vintage; Albania, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, and Greece remain separate country partitions, and no gap is filled by nearest evidence.
Recipients, residents, owners, occupants, phones, credentials, title records, civil-status fields, and protected cadastral attributes never enter public artifacts.
Non-geographic fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
